title.narrative: Integrated GBV and CP response to communities projected to face protection-related risk from the effects of El Nino-induced riverine flooding in Jowhar District, Middle Shebellle Region.

description.narrative: ltpgtAMARD will provide direct CP and GBV case management for up to 440 children ( up to 50% to be girls) and 540 survivors (280 women, 240 girls while men and boys anticipated to be up to 20 survivors relative to previous prevalence and reporting trends). AMARD will facilitate referrals, Psychosocial support services including Psychological First Aid within the existing community protection desks, one-stop center, women and girl’s friendly spaces, and child-friendly spaces with trained CP / GBV case workers. AMARD will facilitate the transport for Survivors to access Clinical management of Rape services (as well as capacity building on CMR to health care providers) as part of essential services for the recovery of survivors of GBV within case management process for medical support.ltbrgtAMARD will support the Identification, tracing, and re-unification of up to 360 Unaccompanied and Separated Children (estimating 50% to be girls), while also accessing and linking to appropriate, alternative care during tracing or when family tracing is not possible and it is in line with the CM SoP as well as Child Protection Minimum standard on the best interest of the children. AMARD anticipates the reunification at 90% to 100% in line with the Child Protection Minimum Standards in humanitarian action for IDTR. The project will strengthen existing service delivery points including safe spaces for children and women (Child-Friendly Spaces (CFS), women and girls’ friendly spaces, One-stop center, and available protection desks) this will be complemented by the procurement and distribution of community emergency PSS kits for up to 700 children and 100 community volunteers or caregivers under the supervision of deployed of social workers/ mobile teams to IDP camps and affected communities. These 800 kits for use at the designated safe spaces will be part of strengthening community-based mechanisms for a sustainable approach in creating an environment that foster opportunity for play as part of growth and development as well as activities for psychosocial and mental well-being. ltbrgtAMARD also proposes to include support for cash and voucher assistance to 250 GBV survivors (including women and girls at risk) whose situations are made worse by the floods, integrated through case management systems, livelihood activities, and conditional cash transfers of up to 75 USD (within the standard GBV criteria) to individual vulnerable women and girls. lt/pgtltpgtTo improve access to service, the project will contribute to the process of updating service mappings, development and management of protection referral mechanisms at the site level, and link to the regional/ state as well as the country networks engaging directly with 1200 beneficiaries (200 women, 400 girls, 200 men and 400 boys) and expectations would be to facilitate referral for up to 685 beneficiaries (395 UASC and 290 survivors). For the most vulnerable beneficiaries and children being reunified, the project will support at a cost of 20 USD per each case. The project will focus activities with beneficiaries from Bayxaaw, Gumbe, Baarey, Isnaabiasa IDP Camp, Jilyaale IDP Camp and Sheikh Omar IDP Camp for up to 6066 direct beneficiaries where children are at risk of being separated from their primary caregivers during emergencies, either as a direct result of the emergency or as a result of its consequences such as seeking assistance and support / or during movement. Respective AOR activities including IDP receiving sites, GBV, and child protection, will ensure coordination with camp coordination and camp management cluster (CCCM) as well as other service providers. Only 7,063 children out of the anticipated 32,720 children in Jowhar have been reached by CP services (hence barely 22%) while the analysis from GBV IMS shows risks ranging from 15% of incidents were sexual violence (rape 9 %, sexual assault 6%) and harmful practices at 17% like early marriage hence need early interventions and response during floods. ltbrgtlt/pgt
